intended_object: A bundling constructor, the analogue of `ModuleCat.of`. It packages a type `M` that carries its module structures and a right A∞-module structure `MM` over `AA` into an object of the bundled category `AInfinityRightModuleCat AA`. This is inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body only sets the carrier to `M`, takes the `AddCommGroup` and `Module R` instances already on `M`, and sets `str := MM`. It is the usual Lean pattern of an `of` constructor for a bundled category, an `abbrev` so that the carrier unfolds to the type you supply. It is the "same" structure seen as an object of the category, not a separate mathematical notion. It is also correct for that purpose: it adds no conditions and leaves none out. Its generality is exactly that of the structure it bundles, so it is not too narrow. As a pure bundling and implementation device it has no mathematical counterpart of its own.
